target_scope.candidate_unit: standardized 26.3154 km2 analytical catchment around each candidate center
target_scope.screening_purpose: prioritize locations for a routine-led neighborhood lifestyle center concept

sources.title: PARC Bangna Bangkok Top 10 Release 1.5 Analysis and UX/UI
Venue Locale Fundamental Data Audit v0.1
J Lifestyle Center Design System v0.3
Current operator, owner and official venue sources checked 2026-07-28

transferable_principles.statement: The concept should earn repeat visits through ordinary weekly routines, not depend on occasional destination traffic.
transferable_principles.transfer_limit: This does not transfer observed visit frequency or demand from PARC Bangna to any candidate.
screening_implications: Reward resident, worker and family routines that can repeat across dayparts.
Treat destination traffic as additive rather than sufficient.

transferable_principles.statement: Food can be the first reason to enter, but the place must create credible next stops across the tenant journey.
transferable_principles.transfer_limit: No specific restaurant, tenant or revenue mix is assumed to transfer.
screening_implications: Assess whether a catchment can support food plus services, wellness, family and everyday retail.
Penalize strategies that rely on a single anchor without a repeatable cross-tenant loop.

transferable_principles.statement: A calm, legible and connected environment is a core strategic gap against broad or hectic shopping destinations.
transferable_principles.transfer_limit: Landscape style and architecture must respond to each parcel and cannot be copied literally.
screening_implications: Prefer locations where an everyday refuge is differentiated from existing competitors.
Test safe access, shade, dwell time and continuity between tenants at parcel stage.

transferable_principles.statement: Existing shopping centers reduce room when they already serve the same routines, but can reveal an opportunity when their offer is destination-led, fragmented or weak in calm repeat use.
transferable_principles.transfer_limit: Competitor weakness is a strategic hypothesis until verified by field observation and customer research.
screening_implications: Separate competitor impact from strategic whitespace.
Do not equate a high venue count with strong direct competition.
Do not infer GLA or current tenant count from low-quality proxy fields.

site_specific_facts.statement: Any named PARC Bangna tenant roster and current operating mix belong to the reference project only.
Parcel access, visibility, parking and nearby traffic conditions in the reference brief are not evidence for a new site.
Any operating or commercial performance of PARC Bangna is not included in this screening evidence.

indicators.label: Release 1.5 catchment and concept-fit score
indicators.interpretation: Higher scores indicate a stronger same-rule catchment and concept-fit baseline before competition.

indicators.label: Competitive room after pressure and strategic-gap review
indicators.interpretation: Higher scores indicate more room to win after considering competitor impact, overlap and concept whitespace; this diagnostic changes the action tier but is not mixed into the baseline rank until route and barrier evidence is complete.

indicators.label: Evidence readiness
indicators.interpretation: Higher scores mean competitor status, location and impact basis are better supported; this does not improve opportunity rank.

disqualifiers: No feasible parcel with safe multi-direction access and service circulation.
A direct competitor controls the same routine with materially stronger access, parking and tenant economics.
The business case requires transferring unverified PARC Bangna performance or proxy GLA values.

hypotheses.statement: A calm garden-like everyday refuge can differentiate the concept even inside a competitor-dense market.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Observe competitor journeys and interview residents across weekday and weekend dayparts before parcel commitment.
hypotheses.claim_restriction: Do not claim unmet demand or competitor weakness until fieldwork confirms it.

hypotheses.statement: A medium local center may be addressable when its proposition is narrower and the new parcel can support a more connected tenant journey.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Compare access, dwell, tenant adjacency, repeat use and customer switching at each direct competitor.
hypotheses.claim_restriction: Do not treat smaller scale alone as proof that the competitor is weak.

must_validate: Current competitor operating status and customer proposition.
Parcel-level access, frontage, parking, servicing and development economics.
Repeat routines and cross-tenant journeys in at least four dayparts.
Whether the apparent strategic gap is important enough to change customer behavior.
prohibited_transfers: Do not transfer tenants, commercial performance, traffic or parking assumptions from PARC Bangna.
Do not use other project briefs as operating evidence for these candidates.
Do not label POI hulls or buffers as source, legal or parcel boundaries.
Do not use low-confidence proxy GLA or tenant-count fields as verified competitor size.
